_doc: Real trolleybus (type, paint from the register) -> custom Czech pak128 object in VZ-DPPraha-trolleybus.pak. First matching rule wins. 'chain' = every object in order (articulated vehicles are several objects built as one); 'core' = the name shown in the vehicle cell. Read from the pak128 checkout (build/VZ-DPPraha-trolleybus/*.dat, main b84c15c, 28 Sep 2026). All objects are waytype=road, engine_type=electric: the game needs no overhead wire, so the battery sections are information only.

rules.note: car 509 wears the purple '90 years of Prague trolleybuses' wrap; the pak has only the PID grey-red livery
